question: Find time-scoped annals evidence for first-print chronology while distinguishing completion, print, distribution, print approval, prior draft, and physical copy.

events.name: 《文宗实录》1452-02-20《高丽史节要》进呈及请求印颁
events.original_extract: 宗瑞啓曰: "他國之史, 尙且求見, 況我國之史乎? 大臣頗有求觀者, 宜速印之, 頒諸中外。 ..." 上曰: "史者, 欲示後世, 以爲勸懲, 不可隱諱, 當印而頒之。"
attested: 35-volume Jeolyo work offered to throne in record
request and royal approval for printing and distribution
not_attested: same day copies delivered or distributed

events.name: 《端宗实录》1452-11-28《高丽史》印刷奏准
events.original_extract: 春秋館啓請印《高麗史》, 從之。
attested: Chunchugwan requested printing and royal approval recorded
not_attested: number of copies printed or any surviving current copy

events.name: 《端宗实录》1454-10-13全史少印内府、节要印颁及再请广布
events.original_extract: 故但印《節要》頒賜, 而《全史》則少印, 只藏內府。 ... 請印《全史》廣布。 從之。
attested: at 1454 hearing Lee Geuk-gam reported Jeolyo had been printed and bestowed
at 1454 hearing Lee reported full Goryeosa already printed in limited quantity kept inside palace
request to print and widely distribute full history was approved
not_attested: which exact month earlier limited copies had been completed
completion of 1454 newly approved widespread print
first-print impression lineage of surviving Eulhae or woodblock originals

events.name: 《成宗实录》1482-02-13梁诚之追述1448《高丽史》旧稿已印而停赐
events.original_extract: 臣竊觀春秋館, 有一件《高麗史》, 或稱權草、或稱紅衣草、或稱全文。 世宗戊辰, 下鑄字所印出, 命臣監校, 印畢世宗聞修史不公, 命停頒賜。
attested: 1482 memorial reported an earlier draft also called 權草/紅衣草/全文
memorial states Sejong 戊辰 1448 that draft was printed then distribution stopped
not_attested: same work recension as 1451 final 137-juan Goryeosa
1453 first printing of current final work disproved
surviving GK05554 contains that 1448 draft print

conclusions.chronology_dispute_1452_vs_1453: STILL_UNRESOLVED_FOR_EXACT_COMPLETION_MONTH; 1454 report bounds limited printing before 1454-10-13 if accepted
